## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Analysis

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g), fill = species) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Penguin Body Mass by Species", x = "Species", y = "Body Mass")
```
